body:
Preserves the frontier-capability investigation with mission status **NOT_ACHIEVED**. No candidate established a new consequential scientific output or an advantage over its strongest equally informed competitor.

N817 records the conditional circuitwise extension of N769/N771 rate-free flux relocation, its exact equal-gate-budget fixture, and the dormant-exchange counterexample. N818 keeps three acquisition boundaries distinct: hidden-channel rare-event certification, remote-coupling response precision, and topology/eligibility limits for a proposed generic DNA-frame repair operation. Existing methods, supplied versus acquired inputs, uncertainty, full costs, and open physical/priority gates remain explicit. The original source claims and historical checkpoints are preserved.

The authored campaign packet retains all 32 worker reports, code, derived evidence, source locators and versioned replay receipts. Acquired primary-source data/binaries remain in the complete local source archive; the public packet declares their omission. Twenty-seven distinct calculations succeeded across 29 attempts; two initial missing-dependency failures and successful retries remain recorded. These are finite execution and data-reanalysis results, not physical validation or novelty clearance.

Validation: 14 of 15 scoped checks passed, including FP integrity/authority checks, generated-access build/check, earlier FL preservation and relevant deterministic fixtures. Both complete-local and authored publication archives passed fresh-extraction manifest verification. The normal checkpoint publisher remains blocked by inherited `unsupported checkpoint schema`; the two new parent-linked checkpoints were appended under the existing lock, individually validated, and their limited scope is recorded. Global checkpoint validation is not reported as passing.
